Name: MALE CLOTHING - Frogwares Sherlock Holmes Pack - Outfit Presets FS - Fashion Sense
Author: marmuruah
Description:
This mod allows you to dress up your farmer as characters from[b] Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One [/b]and [b]Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened (2023)[/b] using [b]Fashion Sense[/b].[b] [/b]For convenience, the pack includes presets for 9 complete outfits, but you are free to mix and match individual clothing pieces to create your own combinations if you wish.

[b]The mod includes 9 full outfits (listed in alphabetical order):
